_meta.what: Regular weekly schedules (Masses, confession, Eucharistic adoration) transcribed from each parish's own website, for the 37 parishes whose sites crawled OK.
_meta.source_snapshot: Pages cached by ingest/public/parish_sites.py on 2026-10-25/26 (data/raw/parish_sites/<id>/, gitignored). Page URLs are in each entry's src.
_meta.curated_by: Research agent (Claude Opus 5.5) reading the cached page text; every entry carries an evidence snippet (ev, at most 15 words) that build_offerings.py re-checks against the cached page.
rules: Only the regular schedule is transcribed. Holiday, Holy Day, Christmas/Easter, Simbang Gabi and other dated one-off schedules are skipped.
Parish office / rectory / building hours are never counted.
season: regular (default) | school_year (counted, flagged) | advent_lent or lent (NOT counted in weekly totals).
freq: weekly (default) | monthly (counted as 12/52 of a week, flagged).
end: null means the site gives a start time only (open-ended); hours are then not stated.
lang: ISO 639-1 code; lang_stated=false means the site does not name the language (almost always English).
days: Sun Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat, ranges like Mon-Fri, lists like Mon,Wed,Fri, or Daily.
